name: Tabs
description: Automatically activated horizontal tabs with related panels.

scrollControls.description: Include the initially hidden scroll buttons in rendered markup.

tab.description: Shared fallback inside a tab button, with item, isActive and index.

panel.description: Shared fallback for the active panel, with activeValue.

panel{UpperCamelValue}.description: Trusted content inside an item panel.

change.description: Vue historical name for an enabled tab activation.
